text:
Marta: Morning — router drama today. uploaded a pic of the 'cozy corner' but only 2 bars of Wi-Fi. anyone else seeing Comcast weirdness? :sob:
Tom: Same here, started around 07:30. Rebooted the mesh and it's still sporadic. had to tether to my phone for the standup. :phone:
Priya: Cute setup btw. what router is that? plant looks healthy. :seedling:
Marta: TP-Link Deco X20. it's tucked in the bedroom so signal dips in the office. thinking of adding a small AP. anyone tried Starlink or a 5G backup?
Aisha: i run a 5G hotspot as backup — solid for months. tip: put phone in airplane mode then re-enable LTE tether to reduce flakiness and battery drain. :battery:
Marta: oooh dm me the model? doing a 30s poll — vote with emoji: :rocket: = buy new AP, :laptop: = tinker with mesh placement, :phone: = use phone hotspot, :coffee: = suffer until ISP fixes it
Tom: :phone:
Priya: :laptop:
Aisha: :phone:
Marta: :rocket:
ops-bot: Incident: Comcast outage reported in this area (approx 23 affected). https://status.example.com/commcast -- updates incoming.
Tom: thanks @ops-bot — good to know it's not just my apartment.
Priya: Marta your desk vibes = 10/10. also lol at the perfectly aligned mug. you should submit to #random 'WFH desk of the week'.
Marta: i'll upload the full photo after standup. need to hide the pile of chargers first. :sweat_smile:
Tom: pro tip: run `ping 8.8.8.8 -t` (or just long-running pings) during a call to see intermittent drops — saved me in a client call last week.
Priya: adding that to my saved tips doc. :memo:
Aisha: DM sent Marta with my hotspot model and a tiny config note. :mailbox_with_mail:
Marta: thanks everyone — we survived standup and now it's time for coffee. :clap:
